primary_method: mid-cycle croupier owner-cash discount (core fee engine) with explicit performance-fee reserve
weighting_rationale: All three final raters vote watch and treat Simplex as a Japan ETF/institutional fee croupier, not a quality-reinvestment compounder. The routed economic claim is additive component owner cash: mid-cycle ¥137.14/sh owner cash capitalized in core_fee_engine, plus bounded ETF pipeline and net claims, minus a performance-fee cycle reserve. That filing-locked fee mechanism dominates Buffett/Weschler quality screens (outside power zone) and is corroborated by Hohn competitive-advantage and Munger inversion reviews. Do not average contract base ~17% at ¥757 with Lawrence synthesis ~38%; the gap is terminal-multiple and growth judgment, not a reason to blend. Preserve Buffett outside_power_zone dissent: approve is blocked until liquidity and reinvestment ROIC are investable facts.
agreed_facts: FY2026 filings show revenue about ¥22.5B and AUM about ¥1.34tn, with success fees roughly 65% of combined fees in the peak year.
Contract backfill reaches decision_grade: four additive components sum to about ¥2,264/sh base with valid calculation proofs and clean overlap keys.
Mid-cycle owner cash anchor is ¥137.14/sh (FY2025), not FY2026 peak EPS ¥317.33/sh.
Contract base annualized return is about 16.94% over seven years at a ¥757 entry assumption versus a 12% hurdle.
All three round-two votes are watch; none approve capital deployment.
disputed_facts: Executable entry price: Yahoo/BVPS-linked ¥757 versus last documented print ¥464 on 100 shares, with live_price_confirmed false.
Whether Japan ETF adoption makes success fees structural rather than cyclical above the ¥137/sh mid-cycle anchor.
ETF product pipeline ¥100/sh remains a judgment overlay without a reinvestment-rate and incremental ROIC ledger.
Holdco versus subsidiary cash upstream and yuho segment bridges are not fully closed in the frozen packet.

value_range_per_share.low: contract low path implied by ~6–7% annualized returns at contested entry
value_range_per_share.high: contract high path ~27% annualized if entry and fee durability both clear

entry_range.preferred_max_for_watchlist: only after broker-confirmed live TSE quote with depth; do not size on ¥757 if it equals BVPS without trade

dissent_preserved: buffett_weschler: outside_power_zone — croupier/partial moat fails quality-reinvestment screen; watch only as cross-check.
munger: low confidence until live tape and yuho close circle-of-competence gaps.
hohn: competitive-advantage durability versus global ETF sponsors unproven; liquidity may make cheapness unharvestable.

operational_milestones: Broker or exchange confirmation of live TSE bid-ask, depth, and ADV post 1-for-20 split.
Quarterly bridge of base fees versus success fees; test two-quarter mean reversion below mid-cycle owner cash.
EDINET yuho (E31267) segment, related-party, and subsidiary dividend upstream reconciliation.
Disclose reinvestment rate and incremental ROIC on retained owner cash for the ETF pipeline overlay.

success fees fall more than 25–30% YoY for two consecutive quarters without base-fee offset

Success-fee collapse without AUM/base-fee offset while operating margin compresses below ~35%.
No investable secondary market after reasonable monitoring — cheapness remains theoretical.
